subject: Request: CEO attendance and slot coordination for architecture deep-dive (ClearWave)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@clearwave.io>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: CEO attendance and slot coordination for architecture deep-dive (ClearWave)

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for the time today. As discussed, we'd like to run a focused technical deep-dive on our inference runtime and deployment controls with your platform and architecture teams. For the conversation to be actionable (rollout decisions + SLA thresholds) it would be ideal if ClearWave's CEO or a primary executive sponsor could join the last 20–25 minutes for Q&A and decisioning.

High-level plan: 60–75 minutes total — 25–30 min architecture walkthrough + 25–30 min focused integration/ops discussion + 15 min executive Q&A. Attached are a short agenda and pre-read.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tues, Dec 8 — 10:00–11:15 AM PT
- Wed, Dec 9 — 2:00–3:15 PM PT
- Thu, Dec 10 — 9:00–10:15 AM PT

Please let me know which works best for you and whether your CEO (or an executive delegate) can join the tail end. If none work, share two 60–90 minute slots that fit your exec calendar and we will accommodate.

I can send an invite once we lock a slot.

Attachments: deep-dive-agenda.pdf, pre-read-architecture.md

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

Redwood Inference — production-first LLM inference for engineering teams

Ben —

Thanks for the overview and the pre-read. We're interested — the architecture walkthrough is exactly what our platform team needs before committing to a pilot. A couple of notes and constraints from our side:

- Our CEO, Lisa Chen, is available Dec 8 but only between 9:30–10:30 AM PT; she can join the first 30 minutes if we make the exec block earlier. Otherwise she can join the start of the session for a brief alignment and leave after 30 minutes.
- If Lisa can't make the last 20 minutes consistently, our VP of Engineering (Megan Li) can cover decisioning on behalf of execs. Megan is cc'd.
- Could you confirm the list of ClearWave/Redwood attendees and any ask of the CEO in advance? Lisa prefers a one-page bullet summary of decisions we expect from her.

Proposed preference: Dec 8 at 9:30 AM PT (shorten total session to 60 min so exec Q&A fits). If that works for your team, send the invite and we will route to Lisa for final confirmation.

I attached our internal stakeholder list for reference.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
VP Product & Platform | ClearWave Systems
daniel.park@clearwave.io
Attachments: stakeholder-list.xlsx
